name: paper-spirit-zine
title_zh: 把一张照片变成可触摸的纸灵海报
tagline_zh: 照片仍是主角，下方纸域却渗出山脊、浪线、呼吸痕——像底片在纸上显影，适合做抖音艺术封面或摄影标本。
tagline_en: Your photo stays the soul, while the lower paper field bleeds ridges, shorelines, breath marks—like a negative.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photo into a tactile Paper Spirit Zine poster where the original photograph remains emotionally primary and the lower paper field becomes a source-derived living afterimage: ridge, shoreline, shadow, wind trace, breath mark, or only-if-earned animal-like vessel. Use for photo-to-zine editorial posters, paper afterimages, photographic memory specimens, Douyin-ready art ser
why_zh: 不是滤镜叠加，而是从原图源数据中提取形态线索，生成与照片同源的‘活体残像’，让纸面成为有呼吸的底片。
why_en: No filter stack—it mines the source photo's own forms to grow a living afterimage that shares its DNA, turning paper into.
limit_zh: 只接受单张用户照片，输出为静态海报（非动图）。需要照片中有可辨识的轮廓或纹理；纯色或过曝图会生成失败。不负责排版文字。
limit_en: Single photo in, static poster out (no GIF). Needs discernible contours/texture; flat or blown-out images fail. No typography—layout text yourself.
